description: This is a Java unit test class for the IfMatchPreconditionHeader component within the Eclipse Ditto project, testing its immutability, header key/value retrieval, and condition matching logic.

classes.name: IfMatchPreconditionHeaderTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for validating the behavior of IfMatchPreconditionHeader, including immutability and condition checks.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the IfMatchPreconditionHeader class is immutable.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Verifies that the header key returned is 'if-match'.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Verifies that the header value is correctly retrieved.

methods.name: meetsCondition
methods.description: Tests that the header correctly meets the condition for matching EntityTags.

methods.name: doesNotMeetConditionForNull
methods.description: Ensures that null EntityTag does not satisfy conditions unless '*' is used.

methods.name: asteriskDoesNotMeetConditionForNull
methods.description: Tests that '*' does not meet condition when compared with null EntityTag.

methods.name: asteriskMeetsConditionForNonNull
methods.description: Tests that '*' matches any non-null EntityTag.

methods.name: ListMeetsConditionIfContained
methods.description: Ensures that list of tags meets condition when EntityTag is contained.

methods.name: ListDoesNotMeetConditionIfNotContained
methods.description: Ensures the list of tags does not meet the condition if EntityTag is not contained.

methods.name: fromDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates an IfMatchPreconditionHeader from DittoHeaders object.

methods.name: createIfMatchPreconditionHeader
methods.description: Helper method to create an IfMatchPreconditionHeader with specified EntityTags.
